name: Trachinus

perks.desc:

  •  Increases handling speed

  •  Moderately controls recoil

Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range

  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.desc: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.desc: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.desc: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.desc: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Tenacity
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant weapon damage, reload speed, and handling until the wielder's death.

perks.name: Veist Stinger
perks.desc: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 153 from 9 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6iEksMDGzT5euNuMAEqnVm?si=a9bf49987cdb441a) with @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-Utility PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility roll for applying Stasis Slow and Freeze in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a Stasis build. Trachinus is the first of a new slug shotgun subfamily - rapid-frime frames. Unfortunately, the intrinsic is bugged and the ×0.8 reload animation scalar from an empty mag only seems to work on the first shell reloaded. It's also the new highest damage output subfamily for shotguns. There aren't really any peers to assess against, but the stats look good, and they're improved further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and mag perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/3635232671 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Base Magazine Size is 7 (max 8) and total ammo is 26. You can use the barrel perk to improve Handling and, at time of writing, Assault Mag is boosting RPM by +50 rather than the usual +5 - so have fun until someone deletes the errant "0". When that's corrected, a magazine perk that boosts mag size is probably the play. There aren't any reload options in the first trait perk column - although the Tenacity Origin Trait can max out Reload Speed after 14 kills - so Lead from Gold to generate 25% of your special ammo reserves when you pick up heavy bricks looks good. In the second column, Chill Clip applies +60 stacks of slow per hit for 4s in the top half of the mag, so will freeze targets after 2 hits, synergising with Stasis builds and helping deal with Elites, Banes, Overload Champions, and Minibosses. The Tenacity Origin trait stacks up to ×20 on kills, providing +2.5 Handling and Reload Speed and an extra 0.5% damage per stack (max +50 Handling and Reload, and ×1.1 damage boost) until you die. There's also Veist Stinger which seems bugged at the time of writing, but which will provide probably ~4% chance per hit to refill 25% of the magazine when fixed. If you're interested, Trachinus is the taxonomic genus for weever fish, a type of venomous marine fish with a distinctive dorsal spine capable of inflicting painful stings, and comes from the Ancient Greek word τρᾱχύς (trachýs), meaning "rough". Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

Trachinus is the first of a new slug shotgun subfamily - rapid-frime frames. Unfortunately, the intrinsic is bugged and the ×0.8 reload animation scalar from an empty mag only seems to work on the first shell reloaded. It's also the new highest damage output subfamily for shotguns. There aren't really any peers to assess against, but the stats look good, and they're improved further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and mag perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/2888021255 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Base Magazine Size is 7 (max 8) and total ammo is 26. You can use the barrel perk to improve Handling and, at time of writing, Assault Mag is boosting RPM by +50 rather than the usual +5 - so have fun until someone deletes the errant "0". When that's corrected, a magazine perk that boosts mag size is probably the play. There aren't any reload options in the first trait perk column - although the Tenacity Origin Trait can max out Reload Speed after 14 kills - so Lead from Gold to generate 25% of your special ammo reserves when you pick up heavy bricks looks good. Alternatively, as you'll probably be in CQC while using it, Proximity Power stacks up ×3 times to provide +15 (+18 when enhanced) to your Melee attribute per stack on kills when another enemy's within 15m - a total a +45 (+54) for a refreshable 10s on further kills, so you can invest stat points into other armour attributes. For a second column damage perk, Binary Orbit provides a ×1.25 damage boost for 8.5s (10.5s enhanced) on any elemental kill of the opposite type. The Tenacity Origin trait stacks up to ×20 on kills, providing +2.5 Handling and Reload Speed and an extra 0.5% damage per stack (max +50 Handling and Reload, and ×1.1 damage boost) until you die. There's also Veist Stinger which seems bugged at the time of writing, but which will provide probably ~4% chance per hit to refill 25% of the magazine when fixed. If you're interested, Trachinus is the taxonomic genus for weever fish, a type of venomous marine fish with a distinctive dorsal spine capable of inflicting painful stings, and comes from the Ancient Greek word τρᾱχύς (trachýs), meaning "rough". Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
